actual_constructions_examined.name: Material noun to an action using that material
actual_constructions_examined.mechanism: A learned material stem combines with a fixed APPLY construction, preserving the explicit actor and affected object. Changing a material-list expression into that action changes the requested event, not just its spelling.
actual_constructions_examined.already_present_example: Ada applies salt to broth. Bero takes salt.
actual_constructions_examined.cost: Salt, broth, take and the material-application construction are learned meanings; actor and patient references, sentence boundaries, unknown names and physical marking still have to be written. Material spelling alone cannot choose an arbitrary action or supply its patient.
actual_constructions_examined.selection_limit: 913 explicitly awaits a separately frozen writing channel. A new arbitrary affix spelling or an inherited target register would be a new physical completion, not discovery of this semantic mechanism. No such completion was selected here.

actual_constructions_examined.name: Process to a product or participant noun
actual_constructions_examined.mechanism: A learned process stem can productively denote its output or an explicitly selected participant, but the input/output type and the referential owner must remain declared.
actual_constructions_examined.existing_card: Already considered in the same open-lexicon note, following earlier nominalization candidates
actual_constructions_examined.retained_objection: 1046 excludes its unchanged ProcessFrame-to-FacultySpec reduction when immediately reapplied as though its output were another ProcessFrame, under the bound IT/RF reading; it does not reject natural nominalization.1132 also shows that semantic output can look correct while a later operator secretly reads the original register instead of the returned component payload. A proposed productive derivation must consume its actual input result, not merely share a familiar written stem.
actual_constructions_examined.cost: The process meaning, admissible roles, kind-versus-instance distinction and a reference to the actual output or actor are additional learned/expressed content. Repeated operators cannot be made legal by an undeclared type cast or a remote argument.

actual_constructions_examined.name: Lemma/inflection or phonological family as the writer itself
actual_constructions_examined.boundary: 1222 preserves real lemma/POS/morphological distinctions but its fixed joint source/projection/injective-group condition fails; one source book passed the necessary metrics and is retained.1219 fails its exact contextual body/continuation channel.832 finds a context benefit but no extra co-lemma benefit and fails recovery;833 independently demonstrates its reference-spelling effect without rescuing832.1220 fails the exact finite material/predicate address grouping. None authorizes an automatic extra state, new affix list or a universal prohibition on meaningful inflection.
actual_constructions_examined.selection_limit: Those results do not themselves give a new content-to-word operation or a fully specified carrier. A language audit or another phonotactic parameter would not fulfill the current constructive task.

useful_retained_requirement: A recurrent written part is a productive meaning-bearing part only under a stated composition that determines a changed complete message. The derived value must be the value actually used downstream, with its argument, scope and type paid. This is stricter than exact spell/replay consistency, but it does not require an already confirmed Voynich lexeme before a source-side teaching design can be authored.

Previously known whole-word triples, short forms, ol/olol, diverse interiors and endings remain conditional requirements on any eventual fixed carrier. No unused control form, implicit participant, unrecorded sentence boundary or unknown-name oracle was introduced to accommodate them.
